caption: The drawing depicts a composition of hexagonal shapes arranged in a grid pattern, resembling a patchwork quilt. The hexagons are filled with a variety of colors and patterns, including solid colors, small floral motifs, stripes, and geometric designs. The background hexagons are a cream color, while the patterned hexagons feature colors such as pink, red, blue, brown, orange, and purple. Each group of patterned hexagons is arranged to form a flower-like or cluster pattern, with one color or pattern at the center and surrounded by hexagons of a complementary or contrasting pattern. Some clusters feature a single color family, while others combine multiple patterns. The composition is bordered by a single line near the edge of the paper. The artist's name "Ruth M. Barnes" is written in the bottom right corner, and "L.941 - A." is inscribed in the bottom left corner.
title: Quilt (1 Section)
